5cbb99e750b757ffae3656da21eb40b363d8c172: The real Portal Schedule: milestones as bars over time (with progress, assignee, amount and payment status), their tasks, dependencies and baseline, and the detail panel when one is selected. You can change scale, zoom and columns, and open milestones and tasks; nothing is saved or navigates. Stored YYYY-MM-DD dates remain valid. start/end and baseline.start/end also accept ISO with an offset, without losing seconds or milliseconds. startHasTime/endHasTime and the baseline flags are explicit per endpoint: true shows the time in CDMX; false or omitted shows the UTC day, and a time is never inferred from the string. Tasks keep daily start/due and can carry startAt/dueAt, their startHasTime/dueHasTime flags and actual startedAt/doneAt. Milestones accept actualStartDate/actualEndDate with actualStartHasTime/actualEndHasTime. estimatedMinutes is the known estimate, not active time. Each source keeps its own precision; today sets today's date (defaults to the current date). selected opens a milestone on load. staff is the Console version: «New milestone» in the bar and inert edit/delete buttons in the detail. Includes its own frame (framed no longer changes anything).
